T:P1.4.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated is a leading supplier of innovative Building Envelope products and solutions for more energy efficient buildings. Through its building products businesses – Construction Materials (CCM) and Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) – and family of leading brands, Carlisle delivers innovative, labor-reducing and environmentally responsible products and solutions to customers through the Carlisle Experience.

T:P1.5.text: Carlisle recently published its 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report, showcasing continued progress against its three-pillar sustainability strategy of manufacturing energy efficient products, reducing emissions, and diverting landfill waste.

T:P2.2.text: Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) is a leading manufacturer and supplier of a complete line of premium single-ply roofing products and warranted systems and accessories for the commercial building industry, including polyiso insulation and engineered metal roofing and panel systems. This segment markets its products primarily under the Carlisle SynTec, Versico Roofing, WeatherBond Roofing, Hunter Panels, CCM Europe, Drexel Metals and PAC-CLAD Petersen brands.

T:P2.3.text: Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) is a leading supplier of integrated building envelope solutions that ensure superior building performance across both commercial and residential applications. From the tallest commercial skyscrapers to residential properties of all sizes, CWT’s advanced weatherproofing systems manage the critical flow of water, vapor, air, and energy, providing cost-effective, sustainable, and reliable solutions for buildings worldwide. Our family of trusted, leading-edge building products and solutions includes Henry ®, Insulfoam ®, Carlisle Spray Foam Insulation, and Carlisle HVAC Brands.

T:P3.1.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated - Who We Are - Acquisitions

C:P1.1.text: Innovation Driven by Engineering Excellence | Crane Co.

C:P1.2.text: Crane Co. delivers engineered solutions for aerospace, defense, flow technologies, and critical industries—driven by innovation and 170 years of excellence.

C:P1.4.text: Our businesses are driven by proprietary and differentiated technology, proven reliability, deep vertical expertise, and responsiveness to unique customer needs.

C:P1.5.text: Redefining What’s Possible in Mission-Critical Innovation.

C:P1.6.text: We push the boundaries of innovation, delivering proprietary solutions that set new standards for mission-critical performance across aerospace, defense, and other demanding environments.

C:P1.7.text: Engineering Excellence Built for Mission-Critical Challenges.

C:P1.8.text: We deliver highly engineered, proprietary solutions that ensure reliability in mission-critical applications across the harshest environments—from cryogenics and nuclear to pharmaceutical, chemical, and water.

C:P1.10.text: Crane has always been an engineering led company. As our organization continues to mature, we are continuing to refine our approach to innovation and new product development.

C:P1.11.text: “I am resolved to conduct my business in the strictest honesty and fairness; to avoid all deception and trickery; to deal fairly with both customers and competitors; to be liberal and just toward employees; and to put my whole mind upon the business.”

C:P1.12.text: Richard Teller Crane, Founder of Crane Co.

C:P1.13.text: Our strategy is built for durability, innovation, and long-term success.

C:P1.14.text: We believe that attracting and retaining the highest quality people is the best insurance of success.

C:P2.1.text: Crane Co. Process Flow Technologies | Valves, Pumps & Controls

C:P2.2.text: Crane Co. delivers process flow technologies for chemical, energy, water, nuclear, and industrial markets, including valves, pumps, instrumentation, and controls.

C:P2.3.text: Crane’s Process Flow Technologies segment is a global provider of highly engineered products and systems, including sensing, instrumentation, controls, and flow control products. With more than 170 years of engineering excellence and expertise, Crane literally wrote the book on flow control with the introduction of the Flow of Fluids Handbook (TP410) that is still used as a definitive source in the industry.

C:P2.4.text: Today, with proprietary technology, precision engineering, and material science innovation, we are solving our customers’ toughest challenges in mission-critical applications that require high-reliability in many of the harshest and most hazardous environments such as cryogenics, nuclear, pharmaceutical, chemical and petrochemical, and wastewater.

C:P2.5.text: Crane ChemPharma & Energy designs and manufactures a variety of high-performance products for the regulation and control of fluids and gases. Its trusted brands offer customers a complete and innovative product portfolio designed for the most demanding corrosive, erosive, and high purity applications.

C:P2.6.text: Primary industries served include cryogenics, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, chemical and petrochemical processing, and power generation. As an integrated fluid handling solutions provider, Crane ChemPharma & Energy is well equipped to respond to complex global projects with comprehensive product packages and timely proposals to simplify our customers’ supply chain on a local level worldwide.
